question_sw: Mfanyakazi anayestaafu anapokea mafao ya NSSF vipi?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi anayestaafu baada ya kufikia umri wa miaka 60 (au 55 kwa wafanyakazi wa uchimbaji madini) anapaswa: kuwasilisha fomu ya madai ya mafao (benefit claim form) katika ofisi yoyote ya NSSF, kuambatanisha hati za utambulisho, barua ya kuthibitisha kustaafu kutoka kwa mwajiri, na cheti cha kuzaliwa. NSSF itatathmini miaka ya uchangiaji (minimum 180 months/miaka 15 kwa mafao kamili). Malipo yanafanywa kupitia akaunti ya benki. Kwa staafu wa kabla ya wakati, thibitisha masharti na NSSF.
answer_en: An employee retiring at age 60 (or 55 for mining sector employees) must: submit a benefit claim form at any NSSF office, attach identification documents, a retirement confirmation letter from the employer, and a birth certificate. NSSF will assess the contribution years (minimum 180 months/15 years for full benefits). Payment is made via bank account. For early retirement, confirm conditions with NSSF.
question_en: How does a retiring employee receive their NSSF pension benefits?

question_sw: NSSF inaweza kulipa mfanyakazi aliyefikia umri wa miaka 55 bila kujali aina ya kazi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Miaka 55 ni umri wa kustaafu mapema kwa wafanyakazi wa sekta ya MADINI na kazi kali zinazohitajika chini ya NSSF Act. Kwa wafanyakazi wa kawaida wa sekta nyingine, umri wa kawaida wa pensheni ya NSSF ni miaka 60. Pia, ili kupata pensheni kamili ya NSSF, mfanyakazi anahitaji angalau miezi 180 (miaka 15) ya michango. Mfanyakazi wa ofisi anayeacha kazi akiwa na umri wa 55 hawezi kudai pensheni ya NSSF kiotomatiki.
question_en: Can NSSF pay a worker who has reached age 55 regardless of their type of work in Tanzania?
answer_en: Age 55 is the early retirement age for workers in the MINING sector and hazardous occupations specified under the NSSF Act. For ordinary workers in other sectors, the normal NSSF pension age is 60. Also, to receive a full NSSF pension, a worker needs at least 180 months (15 years) of contributions. An office worker who leaves work at age 55 cannot automatically claim NSSF pension.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anayestaafu anapokea mafao ya NSSF vipi?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi anayestaafu baada ya kufikia umri wa miaka 60 (au 55 kwa wafanyakazi wa uchimbaji madini) anapaswa: kuwasilisha fomu ya madai ya mafao (benefit claim form) katika ofisi yoyote ya NSSF, kuambatanisha hati za utambulisho, barua ya kuthibitisha kustaafu kutoka kwa mwajiri, na cheti cha kuzaliwa. NSSF itatathmini miaka ya uchangiaji (minimum 180 months/miaka 15 kwa mafao kamili). Malipo yanafanywa kupitia akaunti ya benki. Kwa staafu wa kabla ya wakati, thibitisha masharti na NSSF.
answer_en: An employee retiring at age 60 (or 55 for mining sector employees) must: submit a benefit claim form at any NSSF office, attach identification documents, a retirement confirmation letter from the employer, and a birth certificate. NSSF will assess the contribution years (minimum 180 months/15 years for full benefits). Payment is made via bank account. For early retirement, confirm conditions with NSSF.
question_en: How does a retiring employee receive their NSSF pension benefits?

instruction: NSSF inanisaidia vipi wakati wa kustaafu?
output: NSSF inatoa mafao ya pensheni ukitimia umri wa miaka 60 (55 kwa sekta ya madini) na ukiwa na angalau miezi 180 ya mchango (miaka 15). Mafao yanajumuisha: pensheni ya kila mwezi, mafao ya ulemavu, mafao ya kufiwa. Kwa mafao kamili na jinsi ya kudai, thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz) — masharti yanaweza kuwa na masharti zaidi kulingana na muda wa uanachama.

question_sw: NSSF inaweza kulipa mfanyakazi aliyefikia umri wa miaka 55 bila kujali aina ya kazi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Miaka 55 ni umri wa kustaafu mapema kwa wafanyakazi wa sekta ya MADINI na kazi kali zinazohitajika chini ya NSSF Act. Kwa wafanyakazi wa kawaida wa sekta nyingine, umri wa kawaida wa pensheni ya NSSF ni miaka 60. Pia, ili kupata pensheni kamili ya NSSF, mfanyakazi anahitaji angalau miezi 180 (miaka 15) ya michango. Mfanyakazi wa ofisi anayeacha kazi akiwa na umri wa 55 hawezi kudai pensheni ya NSSF kiotomatiki.
question_en: Can NSSF pay a worker who has reached age 55 regardless of their type of work in Tanzania?
answer_en: Age 55 is the early retirement age for workers in the MINING sector and hazardous occupations specified under the NSSF Act. For ordinary workers in other sectors, the normal NSSF pension age is 60. Also, to receive a full NSSF pension, a worker needs at least 180 months (15 years) of contributions. An office worker who leaves work at age 55 cannot automatically claim NSSF pension.
